user: Which currency is used for SEPA transfers?
answer:
What I did: Searched our documentation for SEPA transfer details.

What I found: SEPA transfers are for euro-area banks and use euros (EUR). The docs note SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day.

What happens next: If you want to make a SEPA transfer or need the exact fee and cut-off for your account, tell me the amount and beneficiary and I’ll check the specifics.

fragments.text:
Transfers
## Transfer types
Internal transfers move funds between Verta accounts and settle instantly.
SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day. SWIFT transfers
are used for other destinations and settle in one to five business days. Card
payments are outgoing payments to a merchant.

Transfers
## Cut-off times
SEPA transfers submitted after 16:00 CET are processed the next business day.
SWIFT transfers submitted after 14:00 CET are processed the next business day.
Internal transfers have no cut-off.

Cards
## Foreign use
A card used abroad in a currency other than the account currency triggers a
conversion at settlement under the standard tier spread.

Currency conversion guide
## Supported currencies
EUR (base), USD, GBP, PLN, CHF and UAH. Rates for the stand are frozen for
reproducibility.
